solution.approach: Compress consecutive identical characters into character followed by count.

code.Python3:
import sys
def main():
    s = sys.stdin.read().strip()
    if not s: return
    res = []
    cur_c, cnt = s[0], 1
    for c in s[1:]:
        if c == cur_c: cnt += 1
        else:
            res.append(f"{cur_c}{cnt}")
            cur_c, cnt = c, 1
    res.append(f"{cur_c}{cnt}")
    print("".join(res))
if __name__ == "__main__": main()
